notes: Remuneration uses the separately labelled remuneration column. Expenses and any expense-inclusive total are excluded from pay. Blank and dash expense cells remain unknown (null), not zero.
Source spellings, footnote markers and original names including explicit Chair suffixes are retained in provenance.
The internally stated fiscal payment year is used even when source footnotes discuss earlier appointments, terms or retainer payments.

All printed named observations are retained in original document order, including repeated source observations. Names are disclosed strings, not resolved identities. Only source whitespace and comma spacing are standardized; Providence visibly separate surname/given-name columns are joined with a comma.
The source publishes no job title for these employee observations; position remains null.
Known expense sums exclude unknown/null cells; a printed subtotal never supplies a missing expense value.
"Employee Remuneration" does not include Employer Taxable Benefits
Includes separate disclosure categories. Select a category to compare records with the same coverage rules.
